v1_position: Certification described as a capacity-building programme agents 'should' complete.
v2_position: Mandatory from January 2026. Registration and renewal are gated on it. It is a 20-hour programme plus exam through NAREDCO, REMI or RAGC and takes real calendar time.
why_it_matters: This is now the critical path for the entire venture. Week-1 booking is non-negotiable; no compliant revenue exists before it is issued.

v2_position: QR code, MahaRERA number and website must appear top-right on every advertisement, at a font size at least as large as the largest contact detail. Rs 10,000–50,000 per violation.
why_it_matters: Every WhatsApp brief, listing and social post in the lead engine is an advertisement. The lead engine cannot launch before the artwork template exists.

v2_position: Registered agents must file a half-yearly report of facilitated projects. Delay attracts penalty and possible suspension.
why_it_matters: A recurring compliance obligation that must be designed into the record-keeping schema from week 1, not retrofitted at month 6.

v2_position: DPDP Rules were notified 13 Nov 2025 with phase-in to approximately mid-May 2027. There is no small-business exemption. Notice, consent, purpose limitation, retention and breach notification all apply to a one-person brokerage.
why_it_matters: Lead and KYC data is the core operating asset. Building the consent layer later means re-collecting consent across the entire client base.

v1_position: Workbook note read 'reported down 4% in cited coverage'.
v2_position: Top-8 unsold inventory rose 4% YoY to 525,695 units. Mumbai holds the largest pool at 157,410.
why_it_matters: The direction was inverted. Rising inventory strengthens the selection-and-negotiability thesis rather than weakening it — but it must be stated correctly.

v1_position: Sales, launches and inventory given as absolute counts only.
v2_position: Mumbai QTS is 6.5 quarters and age of unsold inventory is 13.5 quarters, improved from 14.3.
why_it_matters: Absolute counts do not tell you whether a market is sellable. QTS and inventory age are the metrics that price negotiability, and they are the ones a client will ask about.

v1_position: Metro Line 6 at 79.63% and NMIA 'operational live flight status' were the only two infrastructure facts carried.
v2_position: Metro Line 3 is fully commissioned (Oct 2025). NMIA runs 24x7 with international services. Metro 2B, 4/4A and 6 are all in 2026 commissioning windows. Coastal Road Phase 2, the Thane–Borivali tunnel, Metro 8 and the Virar–Alibaug corridor sit further out.
why_it_matters: Scoring a corridor on an announced asset and an operational asset identically is the most common analytical error in Indian real-estate research. The status ladder now carries a weight multiplier so operational assets dominate.

v1_position: Listed as an annual refresh with no current reading.
v2_position: Maharashtra froze RR rates for FY2026-27. The last revision was 1 April 2025 (Mumbai +3.39%).
why_it_matters: RR is the floor under stamp duty and a live negotiation input. A frozen year is itself a material fact for any client comparing the cost of transacting now versus later.

v2_position: Mumbai: 6% stamp duty for male buyers, 5% for female sole owners (both include 1% metro cess), plus 1% registration capped at Rs 30,000, plus 1% TDS under 194-IA above Rs 50 lakh. The 15-year resale lock-in on the women's concession was removed in 2026.
why_it_matters: This is 7–8% of consideration. It belongs in every affordability calculation and is one of the highest-value things an advisor can get right on day one.

v1_position: Weights summed correctly but the workbook and CSV disagreed with each other and with the PDF narrative (Eastern/Central appeared as both rank 1 and rank 2; scores differed in the second decimal between artefacts).
v2_position: A single weight vector and score table now live in one file and generate every artefact. Execution simplicity is up-weighted from 0.09 to 0.14 and competitive whitespace scores are re-based against the 42,865 registered agents in Maharashtra.
why_it_matters: Three artefacts disagreeing on the headline recommendation destroys the credibility of the whole system. One source, one number, everywhere.

v1_position: Narrative recommended the Eastern/Central corridor while the model ranked Navi Mumbai first — the contradiction was acknowledged but not resolved.
v2_position: Eastern/Central ranks first on the corrected model (8.00) and the narrative agrees with it. Thane is second (7.68) because it is contiguous with the pilot belt and Metro 4 links them. Navi Mumbai and the Western Suburbs tie on 7.48; the tie is broken toward Navi Mumbai on competitive whitespace, and the tie is shown rather than hidden.
why_it_matters: The model and the recommendation must agree, or one of them is decoration. Where the model genuinely cannot separate two options, saying so is more useful than inventing a third decimal.

v1_position: Locality scorecard used a 650 sqft carpet placeholder against a Rs 75,000 rent, producing gross yields of 4.2–5.8% for Powai.
v2_position: Portal and market evidence puts prime Eastern-corridor gross yields at roughly 2.5–3.5%, and 3.4–4.8% in Thane and Navi Mumbai.
why_it_matters: A yield figure inflated by around 40% would mislead an investor client on the very first screen. Placeholders must be labelled and must sit inside a plausible band.

v1_position: 'Brokerage/advisory first' with no rate, mix, lag or tax treatment.
v2_position: Commission conventions, a segment mix, payout lags, 18% GST and 2% TDS under 194H are now modelled explicitly, with a funnel in three scenarios and a runway curve.
why_it_matters: Without a cash model, 'revenue-first' is a slogan. The runway curve is what tells the founder how much capital the plan actually needs.

v1_position: One chart of Year-1 effort shares.
v2_position: A 55-hour weekly capacity budget allocated across six workstreams for twelve months, plus a week-by-week 90-day plan with hours attached to every line.
why_it_matters: 'Divide the work' means naming the hours. A plan that does not fit inside a week is not a plan.
